legend-splugen-pass-road.slogan: Splugen Pass Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-splugen-pass-road.story: curated scenic road. hairpins, gorge, high alpine. A one-way ride of 27 km, Hinterrhein to Chiavenna - roughly 29 min in the saddle. The highest point is about 2,200 m. Splugen Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
